column2:
[title27][sentence]
Theoretically, the weight machine is here
to keep you, the interstellar voyager, in
top physical shape as you ply the uncharted
deeps of outer space.  In practice, it makes
a nice piece of "post-modern" sculpture, and you
can drag it around to serve as a coffee table
or footstool when the need arises.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
理論上，這台健身器材
是要讓你這個星際旅人
保持一身好體格，方便
你在浩瀚外太空到處闖蕩。
實際上，它比較像一件
「後現代」雕塑作品，
需要時還能拖去充當
咖啡桌或腳凳。

column2:
[title26]IMPORTANT ENVIRONMENTAL FACT
As long as you stand right next to the refrigerator
like that, its pathetic little robot brain will keep the
door wide open, spilling all the cold air out into the
room and wasting energy.  Besides, the slight chill
it imparts on your ancient foodstuffs is probably the
only thing that keeps most of them from rising up
in rebellion.
column3:
[title26]重要環保小常識
你這樣杵在冰箱旁邊，它那
顆可悲的小小電腦腦袋就會
把門一直開著，冷氣全跑光，
白白浪費能源。而且，那點
微弱的低溫大概是唯一能讓
你那些陳年食物不揭竿起義
的東西了。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Even a veteran bacteriologist would get down
on his knees and retch if he had to look at the
contents of this refrigerator for very long.
The county coroner himself couldn't bear the sight
of that festering mass of congealed fungus you call
a sandwich.  The burger in the front appears to be
moving under it's own power, and the cure for
something is growing on the back wall.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
就算是老練的細菌學家，
盯著這台冰箱久一點，
大概也會當場跪地狂吐。
連法醫本人都不忍卒睹
那坨發霉凝結的真菌——
也就是你口中的「三明治」。
前面那個漢堡看起來
已經自己會動，後方牆上
還長出了說不定能治
百病的黴菌。

column2:
[title27]ROBO-KITCHEN
You're still incapable of using most of this
thing's features.  You pretty much gave up
after taking two days to figure out how to prepare
"baked water".
column3:
[title27]機器廚房
這東西大部分功能你到現在
還是不會用。光是搞懂怎麼
做出「烤開水」，你就
花了整整兩天，之後
乾脆放棄了。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
I'm afraid there is nothing you can
do to that burger to make it edible.  Heating it
up would only increase the mutation rate of it's
new inhabitants.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
恐怕不管你怎麼處理這個
漢堡，都沒辦法讓它變得
能吃。加熱只會讓裡面那些
新住戶突變得更快。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
Now didn't your mommy teach you not to
put foreign objects into major kitchen
appliances?  Why don't you just go stick
a knife in a toaster or something?
column3:
[title24][sentence]
你媽沒教過你，別把奇怪
東西塞進大型廚房電器裡嗎？
不然你乾脆去拿刀捅
烤麵包機好了？

column2:
[title30][sentence]
Sorry, but 'opening' the robo-kitchen is
a privilege reserved for the much elusive
"qualified service personnel".  If you want
to use the kitchen, you need only stuff
some food product into it.  Then again,
very little of what you have in your ship
qualifies as 'food'.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
抱歉，「打開」機器廚房
是傳說中「合格維修人員」
才有的特權，一般人碰不得。
想用廚房的話，只要塞點
食物進去就行了。只不過，
你船上夠格叫「食物」的
東西，少得可憐。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
This is where you keep your "wardrobe".
A few old shirts you never wear are silently
decomposing on the hangers.  At one point,
the closet contained several dozen moth balls,
but they disappeared one night when you
were severely intoxicated and had the 'munchies'.
Leave everything where it is because it would just
disintegrate in your hands.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這裡是你放「行頭」的地方。
幾件從沒穿過的舊襯衫，
正靜靜掛在衣架上腐爛。
壁櫥裡本來還有好幾十顆
樟腦丸，但某天晚上你喝到
茫、又犯了嘴饞，它們就
不翼而飛了。東西還是別
亂碰，一碰大概就散了。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
The sum total of all of your clean clothes at
any given moment can generally be found
crammed into this drawer.  They are jammed in
so tightly in fact, that they have achieved a new
state of matter, and have their own gravitation
field.  Don't even try to close this thing.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你所有乾淨衣物的總和，
基本上任何時候都塞在
這個抽屜裡。塞得有夠緊，
緊到已經演化成一種新的
物質狀態，還自備重力場。
勸你連想都別想把它關上。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
No chance.  You would need a crowbar and possibly a
steam shovel to remove a few pounds of clothes
first; then you might be able to move this thing.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
想都別想。你得先拿根鐵撬，
搞不好還要動用挖土機，
清掉個幾公斤的衣服，
才有辦法把這東西搬動。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
The hatchway at the top of the ladder leads to
the main airlock.  Fortunately, the airlock appears
to be unobstructed, so you should be able to use it to
make your exit from the ship.  Before you do, you'll
need to find some sort of oxygen supply (the ship
being underwater and all).  You seem to remember
having a rebreather around somewhere...
column3:
[title30][sentence]
梯子頂端的艙口通往主氣閘。
幸好氣閘看起來暢通無阻，
應該可以讓你從這裡離船。
不過在那之前，你得先
找到某種供氧裝置（畢竟
整艘船都泡在水裡）。你依稀
記得，好像有台水中呼吸器
放在哪裡……

column2:
[title27][sentence]
You stop and admire the poster for a
few hours.  It's Miss Cuspidor 90917
from the Filth-R-Us Calendar, and
definitely one of the finest examples
of holographic art you've ever laid drool on.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
你花了好幾個鐘頭欣賞
這張海報。上頭是《下流
百貨》月曆的「痰盂小姐
90917」，絕對是你流過
口水的全息藝術品中，
數一數二的精品。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
A few months ago, in a fit of admiration,
you super-glued the poster to the wall.
Although your heavy panting might steam 
it off it's highly unlikely you will be able to get it down without
ripping it to shreds and leaving ugly goo-marks
all over the bulkhead.  In the interest of
art appreciation, you decide to leave the
poster where it is.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
幾個月前，你一時愛慕
心切，把這張海報用強力膠
黏死在牆上。就算你呼吸
急促到能把它蒸鬆動，
也幾乎不可能完整撕下來，
只會扯得稀爛，還在艙壁上
留下一坨坨醜陋的膠痕。
基於藝術鑑賞的立場，
你決定讓海報留在原處。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
This is not a good idea considering the shape
you are in.  You have a lot to accomplish and 
an excruciating hernia is not going to help.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
以你現在的體能狀況，
這實在不是個好主意。
你還有一堆事要辦，
搞個痛到要命的疝氣
可一點忙都幫不上。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
This is the master circuit control panel for
the inhabited areas of the ship.  Right now,
all life support systems are functioning
normally on auxiliary power.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這是本船居住區的
主控制面板。目前
所有維生系統都靠
輔助電源正常運作中。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
The window leads to your bedroom.  In fact,
it provides the most convenient egress from
your bed, and you come stumbling through it
every morning with a sincere promise that you
are now officially on the wagon.  The bedroom is
mostly filled with your dirty underwear, so there's not
much point in going in there unless you're curious
about the origins of bubonic plague.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這扇窗通往你的臥室。
事實上，它是你下床後
最方便的逃生通道，你
每天早上都跌跌撞撞爬
出來，還信誓旦旦說這次
真的要戒酒了。臥室裡幾乎
堆滿你的髒內褲，除非你
好奇黑死病是怎麼發源的，
不然沒什麼理由進去。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
This doorway leads to what you loosely call
a "bedroom".  The term "large festering pit
of dirty undergarments" is more to the point.
You haven't been able to clean it since your
snow shovel broke, so you have decided to use
the window to get in and out of bed. You have
given up on the idea of actually 'walking' in the room.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這道門通往你勉強稱之為
「臥室」的地方。其實叫它
「發臭內衣物大坑」還比較
貼切。自從你的雪鏟壞掉後，
就再也沒清過，所以你乾脆
改用窗戶上下床，早就放棄
用「走」的進房間這個念頭了。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
Even a veteran bacteriologist would get down
on his knees and retch if he had to look at the
contents of this refrigerator for very long.
The county coroner himself couldn't bear the sight of that festering
mass of congealed fungus you call a sandwich.  In the
back, on a plate of what might be loosely referred to
as "spaghetti", a colony of at least twenty Martian stingworts
appears to be entering its larval phase.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
就算是老練的細菌學家，
盯著這台冰箱久一點，
大概也會當場跪地狂吐。
連法醫本人都不忍卒睹
那坨發霉凝結的真菌——
也就是你口中的「三明治」。
最裡面那盤勉強能叫「義大利
麵」的東西上，至少二十隻
火星刺蟲正打算集體
進入幼蟲期。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Yech!  Not only is this a fish from an alien ocean,
but you don't know how long it's been dead.  It
could be as dangerous as what's in your
refrigerator and you don't get points for botulism.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
噁！這不只是一條外星海洋
撈來的魚，你根本不知道
牠死了多久。搞不好跟你
冰箱裡的東西一樣危險，
而且食物中毒可不會加分。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
The hatchway at the top of the ladder leads to
the main airlock.  Fortunately, the airlock appears
to be unobstructed, so you should be able to use it to
make your exit from the ship.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
梯子頂端的艙口通往主氣閘。
幸好氣閘看起來暢通無阻，
應該可以讓你從這裡離船。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Looking down you see a mosaic of hairballs,
fluid stains, food particles, and various unidentifiable
organic substances.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
低頭一看，地上是一幅
由毛球、可疑液漬、食物
殘渣，加上各種辨識不出的
有機物拼成的「馬賽克」。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nLet's not act coy.  What are \nyou really looking at?
column3: [title16][sentence]\n別裝傻了，你到底\n是想看什麼？

column2:
[title26][sentence]
This area is the living quarters where
you do the things that you do best, which
are, eat and sleep.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這區是你的起居空間，
專門用來做你最擅長的
兩件事——吃跟睡。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
You delicately pick up the highly toxic
burger, being careful not to disturb any 
of its indigenous life forms.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
你小心翼翼地拿起這個
劇毒漢堡，深怕驚動了
裡面「原生」的生命體。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nIt's already open!
column3: [title24][sentence]\n它早就是開著的！

column2: [title32]AIRLOCK\nYou place the rebreather in your mouth.  Finding it in\nworking order you proceed to flood the airlock.
column3:
[title32]氣閘
你把水中呼吸器咬進嘴裡，
確認運作正常後，便著手
灌水淹沒氣閘。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
Through the binoculars, you see a woman dressed
in strange, futuristic clothing.  She is carrying
a clipboard and using it to record readings from
what appears to be some sort of weather station.
When she finishes, she steps into a tall cylinder.
She types something into the control console, which
you can't see because her shoulder is blocking your
view.  She then vanishes!
column3:
[title32][sentence]
透過望遠鏡，你看見一個
穿著怪異未來服飾的女人。
她拿著一塊寫字板，正在
記錄某種氣象站的讀數。
記錄完後，她走進一根
高聳的圓柱體，在控制台
上按了些什麼——可惜被
她的肩膀擋住看不清楚。
接著，她就這麼消失了！

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Some of the rocks bear interesting-looking scratches.
Could  someone have been sharpening their teeth on
these rocks?
column3:
[title26][sentence]
有些岩石上有奇怪的
刮痕。難道有人拿這些
石頭磨過牙？

column2: [title27][sentence]\nIt's cold.  There hasn't been a fire here for some time.
column3: [title27][sentence]\n冷冰冰的，這裡已經\n有一陣子沒生過火了。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The grass here has been trampled flat by something
extremely heavy.  It has also  has been eaten
in places.  That large woman must have had a
voracious appetite.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這裡的草被某種極重的
東西踩得扁平，還有些
地方被啃過。那個大塊頭
女人的食量想必驚人。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nTo the north a small peninsula jut out into the ocean.\nYou also see a couple of strange metal devices up there.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
北邊有一座小半島
伸向海中，上頭還有
幾台怪異的金屬裝置。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
A food lookout no doubt.  From the tower that
large woman could probably see edibles 200
yards away.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
八成是個食物瞭望台。
從這座塔上，那個大塊頭
女人大概兩百碼外的
食物都看得一清二楚。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nSome of it has been eaten.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n有一部分已經被吃掉了。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nA few branches have been chewed off.  Otherwise\nthe trees appear to be normal.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
有幾根樹枝被啃斷了，
除此之外這些樹看起來
挺正常的。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nThis tree is uninteresting.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n這棵樹沒什麼好看的。

column2: [title10][sentence]\nIt's blue.
column3: [title10][sentence]\n是藍色的。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nGeez, look how big that doorway is.  Somebody\nwide must live here.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n天啊，這門也太大了吧，\n住在這裡的人肯定很寬。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
There are skeletons of various rodents and amphibians
scattered about the floor.  Apparently, the occupant
sleeps on the floor with these things.  The rotting
carcass odor is overwhelming.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
地上散落著老鼠、青蛙
一類動物的骨骸。看樣子
住戶是跟這些東西一起
睡在地板上的。腐屍的
臭味濃到讓人受不了。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nYou can't make out any details from here.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n從這裡看不清楚細節。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
Looking at the alien ocean reminds you of your recent
experience in the lagoon.  It will be a long time before
you go SCUBA diving willingly.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
看著這片外星海洋，讓你
想起最近在潟湖裡的遭遇。
看來你短時間內不會
自願去「潛水」了。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nIt's previous owner must have become a snack\nfor what's-her-name.  It's been picked clean.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
它的前主人肯定成了
「那個誰」的點心，
被啃得乾乾淨淨。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nThe skull is too large.  Perhaps you can find\na smaller bone to carry around.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這顆頭骨太大了，
或許你該找根小一點的
骨頭隨身攜帶。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nThe leftovers from a recent meal\nlie under foot.
column3: [title26][sentence]\n腳邊散落著一頓\n剛吃完的殘羹剩骨。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nYou carefully pick up the bone.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n你小心翼翼撿起這根骨頭。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
This must have been the homestead of someone
very large--probably that wide woman you recently
trapped.  You see a hut, a tower, and a fireplace here.
To the north you see the ocean and some strange
looking devices.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這裡想必是某個大塊頭的
住處——大概就是你最近
抓到的那個寬女人。你看到
一間小屋、一座塔，還有
一個壁爐。北邊則是大海，
和幾台造型古怪的裝置。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
To the north a small peninsula juts out into the ocean.
You see a couple strange metal devices up there.  There is
someone walking around between them and making notes
on some sort of clipboard.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
北邊有一座小半島伸向
海中，上頭有幾台怪異的
金屬裝置，還有個人在
裝置間走來走去，拿著
寫字板做筆記。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
What is this strange fascination with
bones you seem to have?  You already
have two of them, and carrying three
at the same time would be a real pain
in the neck.  You decide to leave the
bone here for now and to come back to
it if you somehow lose the ones you
have.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你對骨頭是有什麼奇怪的
癖好？身上已經有兩根了，
一次扛三根實在有夠
麻煩。你決定先把這根
留在這裡，等哪天真的
把手上的弄丟了再回來拿。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
To the north you see several strange devices.
The device on the left appears to be some
sort of weather station; the right device
is a tall cylinder with a doorway leading
into it.  Earlier, you saw someone moving
around up near the equipment, but right now
there is no one about.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
北邊有幾台怪異的裝置。
左邊那台看起來像某種
氣象站；右邊則是一根
高聳的圓柱體，上頭有
門可以進去。稍早你看到
有人在這些裝置附近走動，
不過現在四下無人。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
This window looks like several you have
had to dive through for various reasons.
Outside, the island looks much the way
you left it a few short moments ago.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這扇窗看起來就跟你這陣子
因為各種原因跳過的那些
窗戶差不多。窗外的島
看起來還是你不久前
離開時的老樣子。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nThe cage is occupied.  The owner of this\nhut must perform some bizarre experiments.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
籠子裡有東西。這間
小屋的主人肯定在搞
什麼詭異實驗。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Wow is he ever big!  Someone must be
testing an antidote to whatever shrunk
those heads on the wall.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
哇，這隻也太大了吧！
看來有人在測試某種
解藥，用來對付那個把
牆上人頭縮小的玩意兒。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nThis bear isn't going to be hurting anyone.
column3: [title26][sentence]\n這頭熊已經沒辦法\n傷害任何人了。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
The trophy makes you a bit nervous.  That
animal probably put up a better fight than
you could ever hope to.  You had better
hope this hut's owner doesn't come strolling
in any time soon.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
這座戰利品讓你有點
發毛。那隻動物當年
拚死一戰，恐怕都比你
打得像樣。你最好祈禱
小屋主人別這時候
晃回來。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
An hemispherical vessel designed for mixing
and crushing such things as bones, tusks, 
teeth, and eyeballs.  It is currently occupied
by a pair of kidneys from some small animal.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
一個半球形容器，專門
用來搗碎混合骨頭、獠牙、
